description: Evidence-backed Bitcoin ASIC troubleshooting from user-provided logs, exports, screenshots, and telemetry.

defaultPrompt: Diagnose this ASIC miner log. Give the strongest supported cause, confidence, missing evidence, and next safe read-only check.
Analyze this mining scanner export. Group miners needing attention, find shared patterns, and state what the evidence proves.
Compare these affected miners. Is this individual hardware failure or a shared network, power, thermal, or firmware problem?
interface.longDescription: Analyze Bitcoin ASIC miner logs, fleet scans, spreadsheets, screenshots, repair histories, and power or network evidence. The plugin separates observed facts from inference, highlights missing or conflicting evidence, identifies shared infrastructure patterns, and recommends one safe read-only diagnostic check. It does not reboot miners, change pools, flash firmware, tune hardware, or scan public networks.

name: bitcoin-mining-troubleshooter
